lines.en: Somewhere...among a plethora of wieners...
: Futaba Fukuyama! Or should I say...temporary inhabitant and controller of the orc barbarian, Zagull Throat Spear!
: Um...Molly MacCormack...permanent controller of...the elf monk...
: I’m sorry, what was your character’s name again?
: Alentha Amastacia, shadar kai servant of the Raven Queen and master of the elements.
: You’ve gotten yourself into quite the predicament, Zagull...
: But I suppose you are still a bit safer than you’d be if I were to be playing something more in my comfort zone...
: Yeah, aren’t you normally a druid, Molly?
: Normally, yes. But that does not mean I’m not also well versed in the art of...monk stuff!
: In fact, Alentha here was my first serious character in all of Dungeons & Dragons.
: And since she is now up against Zagull, I suppose that makes her a canonical member of several different campaigns!
: Zagull is now about to meet his demise at the hand of someone who can not only traverse the shadows, but traverse time itself and exist in multiple dimensions at once!
: Bow down before Alentha, mortal!
: You’re...really into this and we haven’t even started yet.
: It’s Molly. What did you expect?
: Um...F...Futaba...
: If you...need any help learning how Zagull works...I wouldn’t mind helping you...
: I’ll be okay, Sana.
: I haven’t played a barbarian before, but...I don’t think it seems all that complicated.
: It’s definitely easier than keeping track of a million different spells, at least.
: I just...don’t know if I’ll be able to effectively account for the fact that I will be playing with one less arm than I’m used to.
: That’s right, my dear friend and soon-to-be loser of the day’s first competition!
: I refuse to allow Zagull’s arm to grow back for the sake of this competition as you specifically stated that it would have no bearing on your ability to defeat Alentha.
: Well...Alentha is a character you made years ago when you were less experienced...and it’s still a barbarian up against a monk.
: If I hit you even once it could be catastrophic.
: That’s precisely the issue, isn’t it?
: Do you truly think you’ll be able to land so much as a blow on a follower of the Raven Queen?
: I...really hope so. It would be quite a boring competition otherwise.
I show up at the Route 69 Diner to find the girls already in the middle of...some stuff that I don’t understand.
But I also find something that I understand completely.
Something that is sure to make my morning quite entertaining.
: I can explain.
: Cotton Candy Girl loves wieners! She can’t get enough of them!
: Is this true, Niki?
: You love wieners?
: No! I don't fucking love wieners!
: And it sounds fucking weird when you say it!
: But it doesn’t sound weird when Kaori says it?
: Everything that she says is weird, so no! Not really!
: Ahh, so you’re finally beginning to understand her.
: She loves wieners so much! She won’t stop coming!
: So...why are you here anyway?
: If you knew you were coming, you could have invited me or something. I don’t fucking care.
: Really? Because that attitude makes it sound like you care quite a bit.
: Well, it’s better than you spending time with a bunch of [teenage]girls, isn’t it?
: So...if it’s to protect them, I’m sure I’d be able to put up with you for an hour or two.
: That’s extremely considerate of you, Niki. Always looking out for today’s youth and whatnot.
: I didn’t really know I was coming, though. I’m here as part of a competition.
: Is that what’s going on over there? I know they’re playing D&D since the European looking girl is extremely loud, but I thought you weren’t into that kind of stuff?
: I’m not. But, more importantly, you actually know what they’re playing?
: Yeah. I used to play with a few of my friends from [high_school] in the manga club. I just never told you because you would have made fun of me for it.
: And you don’t think I’m going to make fun of you now?
: I’m famous now, so I really don’t care what you make fun of me for.
: Friendburger, would you like a wiener in your mouth this fine human morning?
: First Yuki...now Kaori. Why is everyone suddenly trying to put wieners in my mouth?
: Because they are juicy, delicious, and filled with growth hormones that make them taste better but also remove tens of dog years off of your lifespan!
: Thanks, Kaori. And no, I will not be...partaking today.
: Put the wiener in your mouth, [nikitemp]. Maybe you’ll like it.
: Jesus Niki, that name was a joke. You can stop calling me that now.
Meanwhile...
: So, the dice have been cast and it appears that Alentha will be making the first move today.
: To reiterate, this will be a standard non-lethal one on one battle where we are allowed to use our weapons.
: Under normal circumstances against normal barbarians, this probably isn’t a battle I would take. But the fact that Zagull only has one arm means I have very little to fear.
: We’ve pre-balanced ourselves at level six to make things even, and the first person to be reduced to 0 HP will be declared the loser.
: So, with that out of the way...
: It’s time to die...
: So much for non-lethal...
: Alentha springs into action, kicking off the ground and sprinting directly toward the one-armed barbarian, her quarterstaff tucked into a hempen holster on her back.
: Upon entering melee range, she gets into position, curls her fists into a perfect ball, and makes an unarmed attack against Zagull’s abdomen.
: Okay, she misses her first attack somehow.
: What did you roll?
: A 14, and I know from memory that Zagull’s AC is a 15. So yeah, first attack is a miss.
: Upon missing, Alentha repositions herself and unleashes another unarmed attack, this time aimed slightly higher!
: That’s an...18 to hit. And...
: Six damage from the attack that connects.
: Okay...anything else?
: Obviously. I’m a monk.
: After her second attack lands, Alentha expels a ki point to unleash a flurry of blows on Zagull, making two extra attacks as a result.
: Can...monks really attack four times in one turn?
: Under the right pretenses, yes. Which makes them well versed at handling situations like this so long as they’re able to not get hit.
: Now...third attack.
: First attack lands for 5 damage.
: Aaaaand...I’m going to use a point of luck to reroll that last attack.
: Another 5 damage.
: And then I’m going to use another ki point to make that final attack a stunning strike so, Futaba, go ahead and make a constitution save. That’s the end of my turn.
: Jeez...I never realized how much stuff monks need to keep track of.
: Yes, it can be quite confusing at first. Now make your saving throw so I can proceed punching you to a non-lethal death.
: That’s a...19.
: Okay, so stunning strike doesn’t land and you actually get to take your turn. Consider yourself lucky.
: Great, so I’m at 39 now. You’ve got a way to go, Alentha.
: Yeah, yeah. I’ll still get you in the end.
: Then...as a bonus action before my attack, I’m going to go into a frenzied rage and-
: W-Wait!
: Hm? What’s wrong?
: Zagull would...sound angrier than you are right now...
: Well, I’m sure he would. But there’s no need to really roleplay when it’s just one on one and-
: But...but Zagull...
: Ah! Okay! I’ll be...angrier! You don’t have to get upset!
: Zagull...grins as he realizes the monk has barely touched him at all and then...holds his greataxe so high in the air that the sun begins to reflect off of it.
: Then he...swings it downward toward the monk’s torso and...
: That’s a 19, so it hits.
: Buuuuuut remember that Zagull has disadvantage on all of his melee attacks because Sana was adamant about her one-armed barbarian still using a two-handed weapon.
: Oh, right. That...was a thing we decided to do...
: So then...
: I rolled the same thing, so it’s still a 19.
: Oof. Okay. Damage?
: Well?
: I’m going to use savage attacker and see if I can get something higher.
: And I did. So you take 15 total.
: Feck, d’ya really roll a 12 with that?
: Yeah. And as for my second attack...
: Guh. I'm already down to 28 after that, too...
Away from the nerd stuff...
: Back, demon! The instant gram is gone and will not be returning!
: Friend, help! I am going to be consumed!
: Sensei, stay away! I have been dying to see Kaori again ever since that first time in the city and you will not take this away from me!
: Sorry, Kaori. I’m not on bodyguard duty today.
: Attractive skull girl, if you continue to stand in that location, I will not be able to assist with the wieners!
: I...will help you!
: Sure, I still think they look kind of weird, but I’ll help either way!
: You...you want to help me grab the wieners?
: Yes! Yes yes yes!
: So uhh...heeeeeey.
: Yes, hello. Who’s the girl you brought with you?
: The one in the hoodie? That’s Rin. She’s a musician too.
: Oh? She wouldn’t be interested in vocal lessons by any chance, would she?
: I...actually don’t know. I haven’t heard her sing before, but...she’s kind of a little distracted right now.
: Can’t talk! Wieners!
: I can not get to them with you standing there, skull girl!
: So is Otoha the only normal girl in your class? Or are there others who were just not able to make it today?
: No, Otoha is the only normal one. You got it right the first time.
: I still think it’s weird that the two of you dated. You’re...not even remotely similar.
: Yes, yes. I’m sure it must come as a bit of a shock considering that I’m now a cultural icon and your teacher is the scum of the earth.
: Well...I don’t know if I’d go that far...
: Believe it or not, Otoha, I actually used to be quite different from the way I am now.
: The Niki Nakayama you see here today is obviously not the same one who dated him, but is a greatly improved version of her former-
: My penis has probably been in her mouth before.
: You-
: Probably?...
: How do you not know?
: She is my fucking student, you dick!
: Hey, she’s my student too.
: Then you should know better than to fucking say things about your stupid penis to her!
: It is not stupid, Niki.
: Can we...talk about something else, or?
: I’m your ex-girlfriend and if I say your penis is stupid, that means it's stupid! My word is law!
: Oooooor we could keep talking about it. This doesn’t make me uncomfortable at all. Nope.
Several minutes later...
: Okay...so Zagull’s frenzied rage is still going and I am now at 10 total HP.
: This is fine. He still has disadvantage on his attacks...and I can still use stunning strike and...
: Yeah. I’ll be okay. Alentha will be okay.
: She’s not going to lose to a fecking one-armed orc.
: B...Beware, Alentha! Zagull Throat Spear is...is going to spear your throat!
: Futaba, Zagull doesn’t have a spear...he uses a greataxe, remember?
: Look, it says it right there.
: Okay, so...
: I wanted to use water whip, but that would mean I wouldn’t be able to stunning strike...which would leave me open to being non-lethally killed on your next turn...so...
: Alentha is going to narrow her eyes as she winds up another unarmed attack, channeling the energy around her and manifesting it into flame.
: Is that...a thing monks can do?
: Alentha’s monastic tradition is that of the four elements, so yes. It is a thing she can do.
: And since your stupid rage is giving you resistance to bludgeoning, I kind of have to at this point.
: But damn, water whip is so cool and I wanted to use it.
: Anyway, yeah. Alentha uses a ki point and activates fangs of the fire snake and unleashes an unarmed attack on you.
: Alentha uses another luck point to reroll that attack.
: First attack connects for 8 total fire damage...bringing Zagull to 22 total HP remaining.
: And the second attack is...
: Another 8 fire damage.
: Wait...are you sure your...fangs of the fire snake works that way?
: I just looked it up on my phone and I’m pretty sure you’d have to use a ki point for every attack you wanted to change from bludgeoning to fire.
: Wait, really? Did I read it incorrectly?
: That’s-
: Oh, wow. Yeah. I’m really sorry. I genuinely didn’t know it worked like that.
: Well...I’m not going to use another ki point on that when I need to flurry of blows and stun you, sooo...
: Alentha uses another ki point to unleash a flurry of blows and gets two more attacks.
: First one misses.
: Second one is a crit, but since you’re resistant it will basically just be normal damage.
: So that’s another seven damage on top of the...twelve from the fire attack and the resistant one. You took nineteen total this turn, bringing you to 11 HP.
: I’ll also use my last ki point to make that final blow a stunning strike so...go ahead and save again and then take your turn.
: Zagull...looks into his opponent’s eyes and spits out a tooth.
: Child’s play...You’re not even half my size and you think you can defeat me...
: The battle...isn’t over yet!
: Alentha readies herself once more and prepares for what could be Zagull’s final onslaught of attacks.
: The sun has begun to set in the distance and-
: Molly, you’re not DMing right now. You don’t have to set the stage.
: Oh, right. Sorry. Force of habit.
: Also, you still have to make your save or you’re stunned.
: Oh, right. Sorry.
: That’s a sixteen after my modifier.
: Damnit! Okay. Probably gonna die here.
: So...first melee attack is...
: With disadvantage, remember.
: I know, I know.
: First attack...doesn’t hit.
: But that’s okay! Because I still have one more plus my frenzy attack.
: Okay...I guess the second attack doesn’t land either.
: Wait, Futaba. Aren’t those Rin’s dice?
: Yeah, I forgot mine at home so-
: Oh no!
: It's not her! It's the dice!
: BAHAHAHAHA! FEAR ME, ORC!
: That’s okay...I still have the frenzy attack...
: Believe, Zagull...believe...
: So far so good...
: Oh no...that look...
: Don’t tell me-
: How much health do you have again?
: Ah! That’s the worst possible thing you could ask someone in a tabletop game!
: Wait! Don’t shoot!
: Time to die, monk...
: I...I have 10 HP...
: Then...
: Shit.
: Wait...you still have...savage attacker...so you can reroll the damage dice...
: R-Right! I’ve never been so thankful for a reroll before!
: Here...here goes nothing!
: Hey guys, how’s the game going? Did anyone-
: Oh shit, Futaba rolled my lucky number.
: MWAHAHAHAHAHA! ALENTHA LIVES ANOTHER DAY!
Roughly five minutes later...
: I did it, Sir! I defeated Zagull Throat Spear!
: It got really close at the end, but I-
: That’s nice, Molly. Congratulations.
: Don’t...Don't you want to hear about my epic tale of bravery and strength? And how I overcame adversity in the face of danger through willpower and-
: I wouldn’t really understand any of it, to be completely honest. So there’s really no point.
: Well...okay.
: I won, though. So...I guess I’ll just text Uta and tell her.
: Things...are really not looking good for the first floor, are they?
: There’s always...whatever other competitions are being held today, I guess.
: Right...
: There are still four more, so we could technically come back if we...just keep winning until the competition is over.
: But the next contest could probably go either way, so...
: What’s the next contest?
: It’s the Chika versus Touka battle, but we’re not allowed to tell you any more than that.
My phone begins to go off in my pocket and-
Wait, I went to sleep without a charger. How is it alive again?
Either way, I answer the phone and step away from Molly and Futaba.
: Hello?
: Hihi~
: Is the Molly and Futaba thing over yet?
: It just ended. Molly won.
: Damnit. The second floor has a pretty big lead then, huh?
: They’re ahead, but it’s not impossible to come back, I guess.
: Course it’s not! Especially since my contest starts right now!
: How long will it take you to get to my house from there?
: Your house? Uhh...like thirty minutes, probably?
: Perfect! Head over right now and ring the bell when you get here. Got it?
: Got it. But what is-
: Love you! Bye!
Chika hangs up and...I apparently have to go to her house for whatever the next contest is.
I slide my magical phone back into my pocket and say goodbye to everyone.
None of the girls follow me for the first time in two days and...
Well, I guess I just...go to Chika’s house.
